message: Well, not just the GOP. The intersection of money and politics in the U.S. effectively insures that just about everyone in the Senate has at least a seven-figure net worth, and the House isn't far behind. But yes, it's an interesting (and, for them, necessary) disconnect between material and cultural measures of class, and it also helps explain why American tax policy contributes to a ridiculously high rate of poverty in what is allegedly the most prosperous economy in the world. All hail hypocrisy.
